a: TypeScript is JavaScript with static types. It compiles to plain JavaScript.
Interfaces and type aliases both describe shapes. Interfaces can be merged; types are more flexible for unions.
The Node.js event loop handles async I/O callbacks without blocking the main thread.
package.json lists project metadata, scripts, and dependencies for Node.js projects.

Express is a minimal Node.js web framework for APIs and servers.
NestJS is a structured Node.js framework inspired by Angular, often used with TypeScript.
